context: Daichi takes Sho-young to plant rice as a small experience for kids.
purpose: Father introducing son to traditional farming.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Dad — the mud is so cold!
lines.style: Bright, immediate gasp of discovery. Quick intake of breath at 「冷たい」. Unselfconscious wonder — reporting a direct sensation to someone he trusts to share it. Natural child's pace.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おう、田植え、楽しいやろ?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging Kansai lilt. Gentle leading question, not demanding agreement. Soft laugh underneath. The tone of a father watching his kid discover something he already loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Unbridled pride in the small accomplishment. Slight emphasis on 「ちゃんと」 — the satisfaction of doing it right. Bright, eager to show. No self-consciousness, pure achievement.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: えらいぞ、上手いやんか。
lines.style: Tender, genuine praise. Not overdone. Soft Kansai warmth on 「えらいぞ」. The kind of father-to-son affirmation that lands because it's specific and real, not performed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Peak enthusiasm without strain. Bright, almost bouncing with the joy of the moment. The natural exuberance of a six-year-old who's just done something real and wants to hold onto that feeling.
